d:
Listen To "Duniya Ne Teri Duniya Wale" a sad song from the movie "Deedar," sung by Lata Mangeshkar, featuring Nargis, expressing deep emotions through its touching lyrics and melody.
Credits:
Song Name : Duniya Ne Teri Duniya Wale
Movie: Deedar
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Naushad
Lyrics: Shakeel Badayuni
Cast: Ashok Kumar, Nargis, Dilip Kumar and Nimmi
